prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic historical biography poster for Napoleon Bonaparte, presented as an imperial military ruler infographic with a cinematic equestrian portrait and annotated life timeline.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dark antique parchment and battlefield-map background, high-detail painterly realism mixed with luxury editorial infographic design. Use a black, charcoal, sepia, and weathered gold palette with glowing gold lines, dust, smoke, scratches, old-map texture, and archival manuscript fragments.

Main subject: Center the ruler on a rearing white horse, facing forward in a heroic battlefield pose. The figure wears a black bicorne hat, ornate dark navy and red imperial military uniform, gold epaulettes, medals, sash, white trousers, tall black riding boots, and a flowing crimson cape. One arm thrusts a long silver sword diagonally toward the lower left foreground, creating strong perspective. The horse has windswept mane, detailed leather-and-gold bridle, decorative chest medallion, raised front leg, and dramatic motion dust beneath it.

Left identity panel: Place a large imperial monogram near the upper left: a gold crowned letter “N” inside a laurel wreath. Below it, set the main name in large elegant serif gold capitals: NAPOLEON BONAPARTE. Under the name add “1769–1821”, then a divider ornament, then “EMPEROR OF THE FRENCH”. Add a smaller motto line: “STRATEGY • EMPIRE” and “REFORM • CONQUEST”.

Timeline cards: Add exactly 8 translucent archival event cards around the central portrait, each with thin glowing gold borders, small monochrome historical scene artwork, a large two-digit event number, year, title, and short description. Use these exact 8 cards:
1. “01 1769 — Birth in Corsica — Born in Ajaccio, Corsica.” Place lower left.
2. “02 1796 — Italian Campaign — Early victories bring military fame.” Place upper left.
3. “03 1799 — Coup of 18 Brumaire — Seizes power and reshapes France.” Place left middle-lower.
4. “04 1804 — Emperor of the French — Crowned emperor, beginning a new imperial era.” Place lower left-center.
5. “05 1805 — Austerlitz Victory — Strategic masterpiece against major rivals.” Place upper right.
6. “06 1806 — Napoleonic Code and Reforms — Expands legal, civil, and administrative reforms.” Place right middle-upper.
7. “07 1812 — Russian Campaign — Ambition meets a harsh turning point.” Place right middle-lower.
8. “08 1815 — Waterloo and Legacy — Final defeat, enduring global legacy.” Place lower right.

Bottom timeline: Across the bottom edge, create a horizontal gold timeline with exactly 8 circular numbered markers labeled 01 through 08. Under each marker repeat the year and short title in small serif text: 1769 Birth in Corsica; 1796 Italian Campaign; 1799 Coup of 18 Brumaire; 1804 Emperor of the French; 1805 Austerlitz Victory; 1806 Napoleonic Code and Reforms; 1812 Russian Campaign; 1815 Waterloo and Legacy.

Additional details: Add faint dotted route lines and glowing map connections behind the cards, battlefield silhouettes, old documents, handwritten notes, and a red wax seal with an imperial eagle near the lower right. Keep all typography readable, ornate, and historically themed. Make the composition grand, symmetrical but dynamic, with the horse and sword breaking the layout for depth. No modern UI, no watermark, no extra event cards, no misspelled labels.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create an elegant editorial-style 3D infographic about 2020–2026 China divorce population, using Chinese typography and a minimalist museum-display aesthetic.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition on warm off-white textured paper, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, muted cream background.

Layout: Place a large black Chinese headline on the upper left reading “2020–2026\n中国离婚人数”. Beneath it, add a smaller subtitle “全国依法办理离婚手续” with a thin horizontal line ending in a small orange dot. The main visual is a dark charcoal oval/cylindrical podium spanning the lower middle, with a recessed oval opening at the top like a stage. Along the podium front, label the years from left to right: 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026.

Chart elements: Use exactly 7 vertical year positions. Show 5 solid rectangular 3D bars and 2 dashed-outline placeholder bars. The 5 solid bars are: 2020 tall ochre-gold bar labeled “433.9”; 2021 shorter dusty coral bar labeled “283.9” with a small callout tag “2021 低点”; 2022 muted sage-green bar labeled “287.9”; 2023 taller salmon-pink bar labeled “360.53” with a small callout tag “2023 回升”; 2024 beige stone bar labeled “351.3”. The 2 future placeholders are dashed transparent bars for 2025 and 2026, each with a hanging tag below reading “待更新”. Put small black dots and leader lines above each numeric value.

Decorative details: Add two tiny human figures for scale: one standing on the left edge of the podium near a simple railing and sparse delicate branch/tree, another standing on the right side near the future bars. Add a large flat golden sun circle in the upper right. Add a tall cream rectangular slab on the far right behind the podium with a thin black vertical line in front. At the lower left, place a wooden semicircle, a leaning paper sheet with a small orange circle, a small pale green cube, and a miniature beige line-chart card attached to the podium front.

Text and legend: In the bottom-left corner add an orange dot followed by “单位：万对”. Keep all visible text in Chinese as specified, with crisp black type and no extra labels.

Visual style: Refined data-visualization poster, tactile paper texture, 3D clay/paper-cut look, muted ochre coral sage beige palette, high-end magazine infographic, clean negative space, realistic soft shadows, precise alignment.

Constraints: Use exactly the 7 year positions and exactly the 5 solid bars plus 2 dashed future bars described above. Do not add watermarks, logos, extra charts, or additional people.\

prompt_en: A dramatic manga-style action illustration of a chaotic family apartment during a long holiday at home, shown in a wide cinematic interior shot with exaggerated perspective and motion lines. In the foreground right, a tired adult man in a wrinkled white T-shirt and dark pants slumps over a mop handle, head bowed on his arm, looking physically and emotionally exhausted. In the midground left, 1 wild child is captured midair launching off a torn sofa, wearing a loose red shirt and shorts, arms spread wide like a reckless dive, with explosive speed lines radiating behind him. In the center, 1 second child in a blue T-shirt and dark shorts runs forward through the wreckage with one fist raised, full of chaotic energy. In the background right, 1 adult woman with dark hair tied in a messy bun cooks frantically at the stove in an apron, surrounded by steam, splashing food, and towering stacks of dirty bowls and pots. The room is in total disarray: 1 damaged sofa with stuffing flying out, 1 television with a cracked screen, 1 toppled small table, 1 blue mop bucket, scattered trash, broken glass, papers, toys, food debris, and smeared mess all across the wooden floor. A sliding glass door or window in the back is visibly cracked, adding to the sense of destruction. Use gritty inked linework, rough painterly shading, desaturated browns and grays with muted reds and blues, highly detailed clutter, dynamic anatomy, and intense comic-book energy. The mood should contrast the idea of wanting to relax at home with the reality of nonstop domestic chaos, like an over-the-top Japanese manga cover about family exhaustion during vacation.\

In the foreground, show a curved stone terrace paved with light cobblestones, a black vintage streetlamp on the left, leafy green trees framing both sides, and abundant flower planters with red, white, pink, and purple blossoms along the railing. The city skyline should include a tall clock-tower church with a green copper spire on the left, a large Gothic cathedral with multiple dark spires on the upper right, several smaller church towers, and one domed building with a green patina roof. Use summer atmosphere, a deep cobalt-blue sky with bright cumulus clouds, crisp sunlight, sparkling water reflections, soft painterly detail, clean linework, saturated colors, and an inviting whimsical travel-poster mood. No text, no people close-up, no modern skyscrapers, no cars dominating the scene. Canvas: Extra-wide 21:9 aspect ratio, clean white background, one image containing exactly 12 storyboard panels arranged in a 4-column by 3-row grid. Separate every panel with thin light-gray borders and narrow white gutters. No captions, no panel numbers, no watermark.

Visual style: 1970s–1980s Japanese TV anime food animation, detailed but painterly linework, warm amber kitchen lighting, dramatic close-up compositions, visible steam and bubbling liquid, rich browns and reds, realistic marbled beef texture, soft film-grain feel.

Panel layout and contents, exactly 12 panels:
1. Extreme close-up of thinly sliced marbled beef, vivid red meat with white fat veins filling the entire frame.
2. Close-up of a knife slicing a long white leek on a wooden cutting board, several oval leek slices visible, hand holding the leek.
3. Close-up of a cube of butter melting and foaming in a black iron sukiyaki pan.
4. Thin slices of marbled beef spread across the hot black pan, beginning to sear and sizzle.
5. A small sauce pot pouring dark sukiyaki sauce over beef in the pan, sauce bubbling around the meat.
6. Beef and sliced onions simmering vigorously in glossy brown sauce, heavy steam rising.
7. Tofu cubes and green chrysanthemum leaves added into the pan beside simmering beef and onions.
8. Hands cracking a raw egg into a beige ceramic bowl, bright orange yolk centered in clear egg white.
9. Chopsticks dipping cooked beef into the raw egg mixture in the bowl, golden egg coating the meat.
10. Chopsticks lifting a dripping piece of beef coated in glossy egg against a warm orange background.
11. Side close-up of a person with short dark hair opening their mouth to eat the beef from chopsticks; only the lower face and mouth are visible, steam drifting.
12. Final overhead three-quarter shot of the completed sukiyaki hot pot: beef, leeks, tofu, greens, onions, and noodles arranged in a black pot, steaming generously.

Constraints: Keep all 12 panels clearly separated and in the correct reading order from left to right, top to bottom. Maintain a consistent anime look across panels, use food close-ups rather than wide kitchen shots, and avoid adding any text inside the image.\

Her face in the first panel is intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangular censor block. A tiny fluffy white sheep companion with round black eyes, pink cheeks, small floppy ears, and a stubby tail appears in every panel. A calico cat appears in panels 3 and 4, white with orange and dark brown patches, round eyes, and a playful expression.

Layout and story: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Panel 1: Cozy room interior with wooden floor, bookshelf, bottles, potted plants, framed wall art, curtain, and window. The sheep girl stands on the right facing away/sideways, her face covered by a beige rectangle. The tiny sheep stands on the floor to her left, trembling slightly with motion marks. Add a tall vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing …揺れてる…ね.
2. Panel 2: The wooden floor has cracked open into a glowing jagged hole filled with a purple starry galaxy. The tiny sheep is partly emerging from or leaning over the hole, sparkling. The sheep girl crouches on the right, concerned, reaching toward it. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right containing ひつ郎、近づいちゃだめ.
3. Panel 3: A vertical oval purple portal opens on the left, filled with a starry night sky and a glowing yellow star. A calico cat leaps out of the portal toward the room, with speed lines radiating dramatically. The tiny sheep stands near the center-right, startled and shaking. The sheep girl stands on the far right, surprised. Include exactly 2 speech bubbles: a small bubble near the cat saying ニャッ, and a tall vertical bubble on the right saying …どこの子？.
4. Panel 4: The portal remains glowing on the left side of the cozy room. The tiny sheep floats or jumps out from the portal while the sheep girl kneels on the right and hugs the calico cat protectively. The cat looks pleased with closed eyes. Small glowing stars sparkle around them, and a few scattered small objects lie on the floor, such as a spool, coin-like circles, a small cloth, and a tiny container. Add a tall vertical speech bubble on the right containing Japanese text meaning “Hey, stop that,” using 「こら、やめなさい」.

Visual style: Soft kawaii manga, rounded character proportions, expressive eyes, cream and beige room palette, gentle brown line art, pastel purple magical glow, subtle sparkles, clean readable speech bubbles with vertical Japanese text. Keep the page wholesome and humorous.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 recurring characters total across the story: the sheep girl, the tiny sheep, and the calico cat. Count the major repeated elements as follows: 4 speech bubbles total on the right side, 1 small cat sound bubble, 2 magical portal/hole events before the final panel, and 1 beige face-obscuring rectangle in the first panel only. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, watermarks, logos, or narration boxes.\

Visual style: High-quality Pixar-like 3D animation, soft rounded character design, expressive cat face, realistic fluffy fur, warm golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, cozy domestic atmosphere, polished animation stills. The room has sunlit windows, bookshelves, plants, desk lamp, laptop, wooden desk, and a ceramic mug.

A plump golden-orange British Shorthair-like cat with cream muzzle and belly, short legs, round face, folded-looking rounded ears, fluffy tail, and slightly grumpy but cute expressions. The cat is golden-orange; the woman wears cream.

Panel layout, exactly six panels:
1. Top-left panel: Side view of the woman typing on a laptop at the desk while the orange cat stands on the desktop beside her, looking toward her hands. Warm sunlight from the window behind them; bookshelves in the background.
2. Top-right panel: The cat sits proudly on the laptop keyboard in front of the screen, facing forward with a smug expression, while the woman sits beside it with arms folded or resting on the table. A mug is visible on the right.
3. Middle-left panel: The woman gently lifts the cat under its front legs from the desk, holding it up at chest height. The cat dangles with a displeased, stiff posture; laptop and mug remain on the desk.
4. Middle-right panel: Tight dramatic close-up composition split by the panel crop: the woman’s face area at left is mostly hidden by a large vertical brown privacy rectangle, and the cat’s face fills the right side in an extreme close-up with narrowed eyes and an annoyed expression.
5. Bottom-left panel: Intimate close-up of the woman leaning close to the cat, nuzzling or kissing its head while holding it near her face. The cat’s eyes are closed, soft and resigned; the woman’s face is again obscured by a brown rectangular block.
6. Bottom-right panel: The cat is back on the wooden desk near the laptop and mug, reaching one paw toward or onto the mug with a mischievous grumpy stare, while the woman is partly visible at the right with her face covered by a brown rectangle.

Privacy blocks: Add exactly six flat opaque brown rectangular face-censor blocks: one on the woman’s face in each of the six panels, including one large vertical block in the middle-right close-up panel. Match the warm brown tone of the scene, with no blur or pixelation.

Constraints: Maintain the exact 2x3 storyboard grid and exactly six panels; keep all panels visually consistent as the same room, same woman, same cat, same desk setup. Do not add text, speech bubbles, extra panels, subtitles, or visible brand marks. Make the cat’s expression the main emotional focus, progressing from curious to smug, annoyed, affectionate, and mischievous.\

A minimal, aesthetic empty street:
European-style or modern urban alley
Clean pavement, soft architectural elements
No crowd, no vehicles, no clutter
Background kept subtle so focus stays on dancers

Top-left: Step number + short move title (e.g., “Step 6 – Spin Lead”)

Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides for both dancers
